title: Operating model first
detail: Defined onboarding, role boundaries, escalation paths, hiring, and career development for FTEs, contractors, and MSP partners.

title: A reliability practice from scratch
detail: 99% availability, a 96.85% repair SLA against a 95% target, and a 90%+ MTTR improvement. Device fleet grew 43% (1,823 → 2,623) at flat headcount.

title: A team that runs itself
detail: Team incident handling rose from 40% to 75% through training and documentation. A multi-vendor RFP across ~1,000 labs and a Tier 2 move to an MSP cut support costs with no SLA regression.
